units.source_text: 据说，那天下午，一个身穿绯红色大衣、专以外国人为对象的娼妇造访寺庙，要求会见住持。

en.t: It was said that, that afternoon, a prostitute wearing a scarlet overcoat, who catered exclusively to foreigners, visited the temple and demanded to see the head priest.

units.source_text: 副司代表住持来到了正门。

en.t: The deputy priest came to the main gate on behalf of the head priest.

units.source_text: 女人斥署副司，说无论如何也要面见住持。

en.t: The woman rebuked the deputy priest, saying that no matter what, she had to meet the head priest in person.

units.source_text: 凑巧这时老师从廊道上走过来，看见女人的身影，就来到了正门。

en.t: By chance, just then the master was walking along the corridor, and when he saw the woman, he came to the main gate.

units.source_text: 据女人说，约莫一周前的一个雪后晴朗的早晨，她同美国兵一起前来参观金阁，

en.t: According to the woman, on a clear morning after snow about a week earlier, she had come with an American soldier to visit the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 被美国兵推倒在地，庙里的小和尚为讨好美国兵，用脚践踏她的腹部。

en.t: but the American soldier pushed her down to the ground, and a young monk at the temple, trying to please him, trampled on her abdomen with his foot.
For that reason, she was demanding compensation.

units.source_text: 假使不赔，她就向社会公开投诉鹿苑寺的不道德行为。

en.t: If they did not pay, she would publicly accuse Rokuonji before society of immoral conduct.
